name: aspen-code
description: Customize an Aspen instance with the aspen CLI: one skill (using-aspen) that is the whole loop — copy a real shape from metacode/compiled/, author into metacode/metadata/, validate offline with the instance's own ac binary, compile, deploy, verify — plus a server skeleton, trigger patterns, and guards: ask before clearing the shared dev set, deny writes into the generated tiers, deny custom UI that ignores the design tokens or rebuilds an Aspen component from the semantic layer.
